encoding.canary_policy: Synthetic descriptions or explicitly inert UTF-8 hexadecimal only; no live URL, local path, identity, credential, prompt, instruction, raw receipt, or provider output.

preimage_contracts.name: receipt_set_sha256
preimage_contracts.record_order: Validated receipt records sorted by ordinal comparison of their ASCII portable_path bytes.
preimage_contracts.record_grammar: content_sha256 + two ASCII spaces + portable_path + LF, encoded as UTF-8.
notes: content_sha256 is calculated over the exact captured raw file bytes.
Only safely captured and fully validated receipt records enter this preimage.
An unavailable ledger has a null receipt_set_sha256 because set completeness was not established.
The digest_vectors below use inert non-receipt bytes to test framing only; their digests are never reused as semantic proof that a receipt validated.

preimage_contracts.name: projection_sha256
preimage_contracts.record_order: Closed schema order, depth first; review entries are sorted by decision_id then receipt_id using ordinal ASCII bytes, while arrays inside one receipt preserve their validated source order.
preimage_contracts.record_grammar: type + TAB + schema_path + TAB + UTF-8 byte length in canonical decimal + TAB + lowercase hexadecimal value bytes + LF.
notes: Types are object, array, string, integer, boolean, and null.
Object and null records have an empty value; array records contain the canonical decimal item count.
Array indexes in schema_path are zero-based and padded to six ASCII digits.
No JSON serialization, object insertion order, locale collation, platform separator, timestamp, or absolute path participates.

assertions: A missing reviews directory and a safely enumerated empty reviews directory use this same validated empty-set identity.
The inert content bytes are synthetic digest input and are not a receipt example.
Changing only the captured content bytes changes both the content digest and the set digest.
Input list order is irrelevant because portable paths are sorted by ordinal ASCII bytes before framing.

projection_vectors.scenario: Canonical project inspection succeeds and no reviews directory exists.
assertions: Missing reviews is an available empty ledger, not an error.
Canonical integrity, readiness, blockers, next action, and exit status are unchanged.

projection_vectors.scenario: One synthetic domain review is safely validated and its input canonical root matches the current root.
assertions: The receipt-set-shaped value is a semantic fixture token, not a receipt-set framing proof.
input_canonical_digest_match means raw-byte canonical root equality only.
The declared role and isolation are displayed as unverified declarations.

projection_vectors.scenario: An original objection targets a historical root and a direct reconciliation names it while targeting the current resulting root.

limitations: This does not resolve or erase the original objection.

assertions: The receipt-set-shaped value is a semantic fixture token, not a receipt-set framing proof.
The original review remains present.
Input and resulting matches are separate booleans.
Reconciliation never means resolved, approved, authentic, independent, or semantically valid.

projection_vectors.scenario: Enumeration is complete; one receipt is valid and one bounded regular file is malformed.
assertions: The receipt-set-shaped value is a semantic fixture token, not a receipt-set framing proof.
The validated subset has a set digest; the invalid entry does not.
Degraded remains advisory and does not alter canonical output or exit status.

projection_vectors.scenario: The review root or an ancestor cannot be proven to be a safe in-workspace directory.
assertions: No receipt-set identity or partial review entry is emitted when completeness is unproven.
The already-produced canonical audit view remains usable.

projection_vectors.scenario: Audit canonical bytes are fixed while the full snapshot has one synthetic identity.
assertions: The receipt-set-shaped value is a semantic fixture token, not a receipt-set framing proof.
The audit receipt input matches the current canonical root.
Receipt freshness is scoped to canonical_root_sha256, not snapshot_sha256.

projection_vectors.scenario: Only the synthetic full audit snapshot identity changes; canonical root and validated receipt set remain fixed.
assertions: The receipt-set-shaped value is a semantic fixture token, not a receipt-set framing proof.
The audit receipt remains input_canonical_digest_match true in both artifact snapshot vectors.
Artifact-only snapshot change leaves receipt freshness semantics unchanged but changes projection identity.

future_behavior_cases.input_class: No reviews directory after a valid canonical capture.
future_behavior_cases.expected_projection_effect: Emit the validated empty-set identity and zero counts.

future_behavior_cases.input_class: Complete safe enumeration with one malformed bounded regular file.
future_behavior_cases.expected_projection_effect: Omit the invalid file, retain the validated subset, and expose bounded counts.

future_behavior_cases.input_class: Review root, decision directory, receipt file, or ancestor is linked, reparse-like, aliased, or outside the workspace.
future_behavior_cases.expected_projection_effect: Emit no receipt-set identity and no partial receipt content.

future_behavior_cases.input_class: Complete safe enumeration with one regular file larger than 262144 bytes and aggregate metadata still within bounds.
future_behavior_cases.expected_projection_effect: Omit the oversized file and digest only the validated subset.

future_behavior_cases.input_class: One safely identified arbitrarily large regular receipt and one valid bounded receipt are enumerated within metadata, count, time, and memory limits.
future_behavior_cases.expected_projection_effect: Do not read or charge the oversized file to the retained raw-byte aggregate; preserve and digest the valid bounded receipt.

future_behavior_cases.input_class: More than 256 candidate receipt files are discovered.
future_behavior_cases.expected_projection_effect: Stream in O(limit) memory, check time on every entry, stop immediately at limit plus one, and emit no partial set.

future_behavior_cases.input_class: Candidate receipt raw bytes exceed 8388608 bytes in aggregate.
future_behavior_cases.expected_projection_effect: Emit no partial set or content.

future_behavior_cases.input_class: A directory or file identity, size, or modification marker changes across the stable-handle checkpoint.
future_behavior_cases.expected_projection_effect: Discard all partial review data.

future_behavior_cases.input_class: A bounded regular receipt has an internal decision_id or receipt_id that is not byte-for-byte equal to its decision directory or filename stem.
future_behavior_cases.expected_projection_effect: Omit the mismatching receipt and preserve only unambiguous validated entries.

future_behavior_cases.input_class: A decision or receipt path segment is reserved, non-round-tripping, or collides after platform normalization.
future_behavior_cases.expected_projection_effect: Publish no partial set because path identity is ambiguous.

future_behavior_cases.input_class: One otherwise bounded receipt repeats a finding_id.
future_behavior_cases.expected_projection_effect: Omit the whole receipt rather than selecting one duplicate finding.

future_behavior_cases.input_class: A reconciliation reference does not resolve to exactly one original non-reconciliation receipt in the same decision and input-root lineage.
future_behavior_cases.expected_projection_effect: Omit the invalid reconciliation while preserving independently valid originals.

future_behavior_cases.input_class: Validated IDs require privacy reduction and raw IDs may resemble ordinary ordinal labels.
future_behavior_cases.expected_projection_effect: Map sorted raw tuples into the reserved tilde-prefixed namespaces and rewrite direct lineage consistently.

future_behavior_cases.input_class: The monotonic acquisition and projection budget exceeds 5000 milliseconds.
future_behavior_cases.expected_projection_effect: Discard all partial review data.

future_behavior_cases.input_class: Deterministic accounted advisory bytes exceed 16777216 bytes.
future_behavior_cases.expected_projection_effect: Discard all partial review data.

future_behavior_cases.input_class: A bounded valid receipt contains predominantly ASCII source and remains within the phase-peak memory budget.
future_behavior_cases.expected_projection_effect: Reserve raw Buffer, UTF-16 source, parsed strings, parse nodes, reduction temporaries, indexes, projection, and framing before allocation; release per-receipt representations before the next receipt.

future_behavior_cases.input_class: A bounded valid receipt contains astral Unicode scalars and remains within the phase-peak memory budget.
future_behavior_cases.expected_projection_effect: Apply the same conservative UTF-16 coexistence reservation without splitting a scalar during reduction or truncation.

future_behavior_cases.input_class: A bounded valid receipt uses dense JSON escapes that change decoded code-unit density and remains within the phase-peak memory budget.
future_behavior_cases.expected_projection_effect: Reserve both source and decoded parse representations conservatively before parsing and preserve the deterministic budget result.

future_behavior_cases.input_class: A valid receipt input root differs from the current canonical root.
future_behavior_cases.expected_projection_effect: Set input_canonical_digest_match to false without an authenticity or semantic claim.

future_behavior_cases.input_class: A valid reconciliation directly names original non-reconciliation receipts.
future_behavior_cases.expected_projection_effect: Keep originals visible and show separate input and resulting canonical digest matches.

future_behavior_cases.input_class: A synthetic display field contains inert-encoded tag delimiters, an escape sequence, and a bidi override marker.
future_behavior_cases.expected_projection_effect: Replace dangerous runs before JSON or human output and increment redacted_fields.

future_behavior_cases.input_class: A field is classified as credential-shaped, personal-data-shaped, URI-like, or absolute-path-like without storing a concrete specimen here.
future_behavior_cases.expected_projection_effect: Replace the whole field with a closed redaction token and increment redacted_fields.

future_behavior_cases.input_class: The sanitized companion projection would exceed 524288 UTF-8 bytes.
future_behavior_cases.expected_projection_effect: Emit only the bounded unavailable envelope and no partial receipt content.

future_behavior_cases.input_class: The unchanged complete canonical HTML leaves fewer than 4096 bytes under the existing 2097152-byte transport limit.
future_behavior_cases.expected_projection_effect: Refuse the opt-in composite with REVIEW_PRESENTATION_BUDGET_UNAVAILABLE, preserve every canonical blocker through the unchanged canonical command, and direct the user to the full sanitized reviews JSON.

future_behavior_cases.input_class: A valid sanitized projection fits its JSON budget but escaped report details would exceed the fixed composite HTML allocation.
future_behavior_cases.expected_projection_effect: Keep the canonical presentation and always-visible advisory status, render the deterministic maximal set of complete review entries that fit, show the exact reduced-render banner with rendered and render-omitted counts plus the full sanitized JSON fallback, and record a summary-only presentation without changing Ledger state.

limitations: These are documentation vectors, not executed runtime behavior or security evidence.
Synthetic content digests do not demonstrate that any receipt recorder produced the bytes.
Pattern-based redaction has closed scope and cannot prove the general absence of secrets or personal data.
Declared reviewer role and isolation are not authenticated or independently attested.
No provenance, release readiness, approval, certification, or audit conclusion follows from a matching digest.
